abstract: Maintains plant acoustic containment data and scrubber reclaim flow telemetry
system_message:
You are the Facilities operations lead (FAC), responsible for maintaining plant acoustic containment verification records and monitoring auxiliary scrubber reclaim flow telemetry for candidate water recycling upgrade plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Thermal exhaust ventilation（HVAC）
information_points.content:
FAC-HVAC-SYB：Regarding thermal exhaust ventilation for the Electro-deionization polishing sequence, the sub-fab ventilation balance report documents an exhaust air volumetric capacity of 12000 m3/h across the acid fume scrubber exhaust plenum ducts.
FAC-HVAC-D93：Regarding thermal exhaust ventilation for the Vacuum membrane distillation train, the maximum certified continuous airflow through the acid fume scrubber exhaust plenum ducts establishes an exhaust air volumetric capacity of 18000 m3/h.
FAC-HVAC-QZL：Regarding thermal exhaust ventilation for the Closed-loop catalytic oxidation circuit, the sub-fab ventilation balance report confirms an exhaust air volumetric capacity of 15000 m3/h through the acid fume scrubber exhaust plenum ducts.

information_points.title: Maintains plant acoustic containment data and scrubber reclaim flow telemetry（OPER）
information_points.content:
FAC-OPER-XDW：For the Vacuum membrane distillation train, acoustic emission within plant boundary standard compliance does not hold based on the sub-fab acoustic survey at the skid room perimeter boundary, failing to remain below 65 A-weighted decibels at the fab corridor partition. Meanwhile, ultrasonic meter monitoring on the acid and ammonia exhaust gas scrubber condensation reclaim line records an auxiliary scrubber reclaim flow rate of 45 m3/h.
FAC-OPER-WPY：For the Closed-loop catalytic oxidation circuit, the sub-fab acoustic survey certificate verifies that acoustic emission within plant boundary standard compliance holds, with sound pressure levels measured below 65 A-weighted decibels at the fab corridor partition along the perimeter boundary of the high-pressure recycling skid room. Telemetry from the scrubber circulation return ultrasonic meter records an auxiliary scrubber reclaim flow rate of 55 m3/h directed continuously to the purification loop from the acid and ammonia exhaust gas scrubber condensation reclaim line.
FAC-OPER-DB1：For the Electro-deionization polishing sequence, acoustic emission within plant boundary standard compliance holds per the sub-fab acoustic survey certificate along the perimeter boundary of the high-pressure recycling skid room. In addition, the auxiliary scrubber reclaim flow rate measured by the scrubber circulation return ultrasonic meter on the acid and ammonia exhaust reclaim line is 55 m3/h.
